system.description:
Tallfellow Halfling

Tallfellow halflings are the rarest and tallest of the three halfling subraces, standing up to 4 feet in height — considerably taller than their kin. They are believed to carry a trace of elven ancestry, granting them sharper features, lighter complexions, and a greater affinity for woodlands and arcane knowledge. Tallfellows are more slender and graceful than hairfoot or stout halflings, and can sometimes be mistaken for small humans or unusually short elves. They dwell primarily in forested regions near elven communities and tend to be more open to adventure than the home-loving hairfoot halflings.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Intelligence: +1
  • Strength: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 30 feet.
  • Missile Attack Bonus: +3 to attack rolls with slings and all thrown weapons.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +4 to all saving throws vs. magic spells, wand effects, and staves.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: Reflecting their elven heritage, tallfellows detect secret doors within 10 feet on 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 when searching.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 15% chance to be immune to sleep spells and +1 bonus to saving throws vs. charm effects.
  • Move Silently: Tallfellow halflings move silently in natural terrain and surprise opponents on 1–4 on a d6 outdoors.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Thief multiclass.
system.source: The Complete Book of Gnomes & Halflings
